description: This file contains TypeScript code defining functions that generate instruction messages for various tools related to task creation, rule creation, bug reporting, and conversation condensing within the Kilocode project. It primarily exports functions that return formatted strings used for guiding AI interactions.

methods.name: newTaskToolResponse
methods.description: Generates an instruction string for creating a new task with preloaded context, including detailed guidelines and example usage.

methods.name: newRuleToolResponse
methods.description: Creates an instruction string for generating a new Kilo rule markdown file, including formatting guidelines and example structure.

methods.name: reportBugToolResponse
methods.description: Prepares an instruction string to assist in collecting information and submitting a bug report to the Kilocode GitHub issues page.

methods.name: condenseToolResponse
methods.description: Produces an instruction string for summarizing the conversation to condense context while retaining key technical details.
